title: Webhook-triggered deployments for Databricks Apps will soon be generally available
body:
Starting in October 2026, webhook-triggered deployments for [Databricks Apps](/aws/en/dev-tools/databricks-apps) will be generally available. Automatically deploy your app when changes are pushed to a connected GitHub or Azure DevOps repository, so your deployed app stays in sync with your repository without manual redeployment.

See [Deploy a Databricks app](/aws/en/dev-tools/databricks-apps/deploy).
